nodes.title: Start here · d1 scene to artwork palette
widgets_values:
DEMO: A specialist decision model controls an artwork. d1 reads a text state, question and allowed palette labels in one Core ML pass with zero generated tokens. Choice to Value translates the selected label into paletteHue; p5 renders the authored circle. Inspect the distribution and timing viewers. This d1 conversion is text-only.

Requires Genereti public. The artwork starts on open, but inference waits for top Run.
1. Download d1 with ↓ if missing. First Run compiles/loads locally.
2. Run and inspect choice, probabilities and metrics in Tree mode.
3. Change only the state to: The scene is entirely orange: orange lights, orange walls and an orange sunset. Run again and compare. Then try a warm festival description; subjective choices may surprise you.
4. Keep the blue/orange options unchanged for this experiment. They define our two authored palettes. Use the mapping node to choose different numeric hues.
